direct_official_checks: OS Terrain50 is a low-resolution digital terrain model
national data is supplied in 10km by 10km tiles
tiles are identified from the south-west National Grid reference
grid formats include ASCII and GML
product is available as online download
national tiled supply contains 2858 tiles arranged in 55 100km folders
product is intended for broad-area terrain analysis rather than parcel precision
quality_effect: Makes OS corroboration reproducible by pinning tile identity, supply mechanism and broad-scale role.
